name: Soy Sauce Chicken
description: Simple soy sauce chicken suitable for a quick family meal.
steps: Marinate the chicken with soy sauce and sugar.
Heat a pan with a little oil.
Brown the chicken on all sides.

name: Chicken Potato Stir Fry
description: A delicious and quick stir fry with tender chicken and crispy potatoes.
steps: Dice chicken and potatoes into small cubes. Slice onion.
Pan-fry potatoes until golden and slightly soft. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, stir fry chicken until lightly browned.
Add onions and cook until fragrant.
Return potatoes to pan, add soy sauce, and stir fry everything together for 3 minutes.

name: Vegetable Noodle Soup
description: A comforting, light vegetable soup with noodles.
steps: Boil vegetable broth in a pot.
Add sliced carrots and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add noodles and cook according to package instructions.
Add chopped bok choy in the last minute of cooking.

name: Black Pepper Beef
description: Tender beef slices in a savory, peppery sauce.
steps: Slice beef thinly and marinate with soy sauce and black pepper.
Stir fry beef on high heat until browned. Remove and set aside.
Stir fry bell peppers until slightly tender.
Return beef to pan, add oyster sauce, and toss well.
